procedure: 2. Exclude any path containing a node_modules, test-results or .git segment. Include everything else.
3. Path form: POSIX-relative to the Block directory root.
4. Order: bytewise ascending on the relative path (LC_ALL=C).
5. Per file: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw bytes.
7. Digest = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the concatenated manifest bytes.
package_tree_digest.reproduce: cd <block dir> && find . -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './test-results/*' -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort | while read -r f; do printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$f"; done | sha256sum
package_tree_digest.why_defined_here: No canonical digest algorithm exists in recovered doctrine. SCHEMAS.md names the field 'package_tree_digest' and calls it a reproducible SHA-256 tree digest but defines no procedure, and no implementation exists in the estate. This is the smallest deterministic procedure sufficient for one admission. It is not a package manager and creates no tooling.
